// 在 v0.24.1 的源码导出里跑（tests/fixtures/old-user-data/README.md「怎么给一个新版本补一份目录」）：
// 用 0.24.1 自己的真实 store 写口（addNode / connectNodes / updateNode + applyArchetypeModeSwitch / copySelectedNodes + pasteNodes /
// disconnectEdge），加 0.24.1 自己的 Agent 计划写入口 buildPlannedNodeMeta，造出「创作者在 0.24.1 里这样操作会得到的节点」，
// 再用 store 自己的存盘读口 readDocumentSnapshot() 取出画布存盘片段（项目文件 payload.generationCanvas 就是它）。
// 输出目录由 V_OUT 给：canvas.json（存盘片段，原样）+ manifest.json（每个节点怎么得到的 + 0.24.1 自己读它读出什么）。
// 不手写任何节点 JSON：meta、边、方式字段全是那些函数写出来的。
// 放到导出里的 src/workbench/generationCanvas/store/zzCanvasModeGen.test.ts，去掉 .txt。
import fs from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { useGenerationCanvasStore } from './generationCanvasStore'
import { applyArchetypeModeSwitch, currentArchetypeMode, ensureArchetypeNodeMeta } from '../nodes/controls/archetypeMeta'
import { MODEL_ARCHETYPES } from '../../../../electron/shared/modelArchetypes'
import { buildAgentModelEntries } from '../agent/availableModels'
import { buildModelEntryIndex, buildPlannedNodeMeta } from '../agent/plannedNodeMeta'
import { canRunGenerationNode } from '../runner/generationRunController'
import { resolveTaskKind } from '../runner/catalogTaskResolve'
import { resolveGenerationReferences } from '../runner/generationReferenceResolver'
import type { GenerationCanvasNode } from '../model/generationCanvasTypes'
import type { ModelOption } from '../../../config/models'

const OUT = String(process.env.V_OUT || '').trim()

// 节点 id 带时间和随机数；固定住，重生成时输出稳定（不改任何被测函数）。
let clock = 1_700_000_000_000
let rand = 0
beforeAll(() => {
  vi.spyOn(Date, 'now').mockImplementation(() => (clock += 1))
  vi.spyOn(Math, 'random').mockImplementation(() => ((rand += 1) % 1000) / 1000 + 0.0005)
})
afterAll(() => vi.restoreAllMocks())

const store = () => useGenerationCanvasStore.getState()
const archetypeOf = (id: string) => {
  const found = MODEL_ARCHETYPES.find((a) => a.id === id)
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no archetype ${id}`)
  return found
}

type Scenario = { key: string; nodeId: string; how: string; group: 'design-card' | 'control' }
const scenarios: Scenario[] = []
const record = (key: string, nodeId: string, group: Scenario['group'], how: string) => scenarios.push({ key, nodeId, group, how })

/** 创作者在节点上选了一个模型（ensureArchetypeNodeMeta 是「节点刚选到有档案的模型」时 0.24.1 写入默认模式的那个函数）。 */
function addGenerationNode(kind: 'image' | 'video' | 'audio' | 'model3d', title: string, archetypeId: string, modelKey: string, prompt = ''): string {
  const archetype = archetypeOf(archetypeId)
  const node = store().addNode({ kind, title, prompt, categoryId: 'shots', meta: { modelKey, modelVendor: 'kie' } })
  const ensured = ensureArchetypeNodeMeta(node.meta as Record<string, unknown>, archetype)
  if (ensured) store().updateNode(node.id, { meta: ensured })
  return node.id
}

/** 创作者在参数面板点分段（NodeParameterControls 的 handleModeChange：updateNode(applyArchetypeModeSwitch)）。 */
function clickModeSegment(nodeId: string, modeId: string): void {
  const node = store().nodes.find((n) => n.id === nodeId)!
  const meta = (node.meta || {}) as Record<string, unknown>
  const archetypeId = (meta.archetype as { id: string }).id
  store().updateNode(nodeId, { meta: applyArchetypeModeSwitch(meta, archetypeOf(archetypeId), modeId) })
}

let imageCounter = 0
/** 一张已经生成好的图片节点（连线的来源）。结果是假的 nomi-local 地址，不指向任何真文件。 */
function addImageSource(title: string): string {
  imageCounter += 1
  const node = store().addNode({ kind: 'image', title, categoryId: 'shots' })
  store().addNodeResult(node.id, { id: `fixture-result-${imageCounter}`, type: 'image', url: `nomi-local://fixture/${title}.png`, createdAt: 1_700_000_000_000 + imageCounter })
  return node.id
}

describe('zzCanvasModeGen', () => {
  it('lands generation nodes with 0.24.1 real store ports and reads the persisted snapshot', () => {
    expect(OUT, 'V_OUT must name the output directory').not.toBe('')
    store().restoreSnapshot({ nodes: [], edges: [], groups: [] })

    // ── 对照节点（任务书基线）─────────────────────────────
    const imageT2i = addGenerationNode('image', 'ctrl-image-t2i-no-image', 'nano-banana', 'nano-banana', '一只橘猫')
    record('ctrl-image-t2i-no-image', imageT2i, 'control', '图片节点选 nano-banana，什么都没放，写了提示词（默认文生图）')

    const imageEditSource = addImageSource('src-cat')
    const imageEditWithImage = addGenerationNode('image', 'ctrl-image-edit-with-image', 'nano-banana', 'nano-banana', '把猫改成黑色')
    store().connectNodes(imageEditSource, imageEditWithImage, 'reference')
    record('ctrl-image-edit-with-image', imageEditWithImage, 'control', '图片节点连一张已生成的图（连线升格成改图），提示词写好')

    const videoT2v = addGenerationNode('video', 'ctrl-video-t2v', 'seedance-2', 'seedance-2', '日出时的海边')
    record('ctrl-video-t2v', videoT2v, 'control', '视频节点选 Seedance 2，什么都没放，写了提示词（默认文生视频）')

    const firstFrameSource = addImageSource('src-first-frame')
    const videoFirstWithFrame = addGenerationNode('video', 'ctrl-video-first-with-first-frame', 'seedance-2', 'seedance-2', '镜头缓缓推进')
    clickModeSegment(videoFirstWithFrame, 'first')
    store().connectNodes(firstFrameSource, videoFirstWithFrame, 'first_frame')
    record('ctrl-video-first-with-first-frame', videoFirstWithFrame, 'control', '视频节点点「首帧」，再把一张图连成首帧')

    // ── 设计卡 ★1c 八种 ─────────────────────────────────
    // ① 空视频节点点过「参考」
    const emptyReference = addGenerationNode('video', 'dc1-video-empty-reference-clicked', 'seedance-2', 'seedance-2', '雨夜街头的追逐')
    clickModeSegment(emptyReference, 'omni')
    record('dc1-video-empty-reference-clicked', emptyReference, 'design-card', '空视频节点，写好提示词，在参数面板点了「参考」（omni）分段，一张图都没放')

    // ② 图片改图节点只复制粘贴自己（带图复制粘贴得到的那种）
    const pasteSource = addImageSource('src-paste')
    const pasteOriginal = addGenerationNode('image', 'dc2-paste-original', 'nano-banana', 'nano-banana', '把天空改成黄昏')
    store().connectNodes(pasteSource, pasteOriginal, 'reference')
    store().selectNodes([pasteOriginal])
    store().copySelectedNodes()
    store().pasteNodes({ x: 600, y: 600 })
    const pasted = store().nodes.find((n) => n.id !== pasteOriginal && n.id.startsWith(`${pasteOriginal}-copy-`))!
    record('dc2-image-edit-pasted-alone', pasted.id, 'design-card', '选中上面那个连着图的改图节点，只复制它自己、粘贴：新节点带着「改图」方式，边没带过来（参考图丢了）')

    // ③ 首尾帧方式，首帧被清空
    const clearedSource = addImageSource('src-cleared-first-frame')
    const clearedFirst = addGenerationNode('video', 'dc3-video-firstlast-first-frame-cleared', 'seedance-2', 'seedance-2', '人物转身')
    clickModeSegment(clearedFirst, 'firstlast')
    store().connectNodes(clearedSource, clearedFirst, 'first_frame')
    const clearedEdge = store().edges.find((e) => e.target === clearedFirst)!
    store().disconnectEdge(clearedEdge.id)
    record('dc3-video-firstlast-first-frame-cleared', clearedFirst, 'design-card', '点「首尾帧」，把一张图连成首帧，再把这条线删掉（首帧清空）；方式停在首尾帧')

    // ④ 首尾帧方式连了 5 张参考
    const fiveSources = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => addImageSource(`src-five-${n}`))
    const firstlastFive = addGenerationNode('video', 'dc4-video-firstlast-five-refs', 'seedance-2', 'seedance-2', '五张角色图一起出场')
    for (const source of fiveSources) store().connectNodes(source, firstlastFive, 'reference')
    clickModeSegment(firstlastFive, 'firstlast')
    record('dc4-video-firstlast-five-refs', firstlastFive, 'design-card', '先连 5 张参考图（自动成了「参考」方式），再手点「首尾帧」分段：方式停在首尾帧，5 张都连着')

    // ⑤ 文生图却连着图（07-28「男角色出女的」那一类）
    const charSource = addImageSource('src-character')
    const t2iWithImage = addGenerationNode('image', 'dc5-image-t2i-with-image', 'nano-banana', 'nano-banana', '男角色站在窗前')
    store().connectNodes(charSource, t2iWithImage, 'reference')
    clickModeSegment(t2iWithImage, 't2i')
    record('dc5-image-t2i-with-image', t2iWithImage, 'design-card', '图片节点连了一张角色图（升格成改图），又手点回「文生图」分段：图还连着，存着的方式是文生')

    // ⑥ 计划写入：Agent / 分镜经 buildPlannedNodeMeta 落「改图」方式，没带参考
    const entries = buildModelEntryIndex(buildAgentModelEntries([
      { value: 'nano-banana', label: 'Nano Banana', vendor: 'kie', meta: { archetypeId: 'nano-banana' } } as ModelOption,
      { value: 'seedance-2', label: '即梦 Seedance', vendor: 'kie', meta: { archetypeId: 'seedance-2' } } as ModelOption,
    ]))
    const plannedEditMeta = buildPlannedNodeMeta({ modelKey: 'nano-banana', modeId: 'edit' }, entries)!
    const plannedEdit = store().addNode({ kind: 'image', title: 'dc6-agent-plan-image-edit-no-refs', prompt: '第 3 镜：同一个人物换到雨里', categoryId: 'shots', meta: plannedEditMeta })
    record('dc6-agent-plan-image-edit-no-refs', plannedEdit.id, 'design-card', 'Agent 起草（或分镜落地）一个图片节点，计划里写了 modeId=edit，没有给任何参考；用 0.24.1 的 buildPlannedNodeMeta 写 meta')

    // ⑥b 同一条写口：Agent 给视频写 firstlast，只带一张图
    const plannedFirstlastMeta = buildPlannedNodeMeta({ modelKey: 'seedance-2', modeId: 'firstlast' }, entries)!
    const plannedFirstlast = store().addNode({ kind: 'video', title: 'dc6b-agent-plan-video-firstlast', prompt: '第 4 镜：门开', categoryId: 'shots', meta: plannedFirstlastMeta })
    const plannedFirstlastSource = addImageSource('src-plan-firstlast')
    store().connectNodes(plannedFirstlastSource, plannedFirstlast.id, 'reference')
    record('dc6b-agent-plan-video-firstlast', plannedFirstlast.id, 'design-card', 'Agent 起草一个视频节点，计划里写了 modeId=firstlast，随后连了一张参考图（连线没有把它改回参考）')

    // ⑦ 声音转写没音频
    const scribe = addGenerationNode('audio', 'dc7-audio-transcribe-no-audio', 'eleven-scribe-v2', 'eleven-scribe-v2')
    record('dc7-audio-transcribe-no-audio', scribe, 'design-card', '声音节点选「声音转写」模型（默认就是转写方式），没有放音频')

    // ⑧ 3D 图生没图
    const meshy = addGenerationNode('model3d', 'dc8-model3d-image-no-image', 'hunyuan3d', 'hunyuan3d', '一只陶瓷茶壶')
    clickModeSegment(meshy, 'image')
    record('dc8-model3d-image-no-image', meshy, 'design-card', '3D 节点选混元 3D，在参数面板点了「图生 3D」分段，没放图')

    // ── 存盘读口 + 0.24.1 自己读它读出什么 ──────────────────
    const snapshot = store().readDocumentSnapshot()
    const nodes = snapshot.nodes as GenerationCanvasNode[]
    const edges = snapshot.edges
    const reads = Object.fromEntries(
      scenarios.map((s) => {
        const node = nodes.find((n) => n.id === s.nodeId)!
        const meta = (node.meta || {}) as Record<string, unknown>
        const archetypeMeta = meta.archetype as { id?: string; modeId?: string } | undefined
        const archetype = archetypeMeta?.id ? archetypeOf(archetypeMeta.id) : null
        const references = resolveGenerationReferences(node, { nodes, edges })
        const ctx = { nodes, edges }
        return [s.key, {
          storedModeId: archetypeMeta?.modeId ?? null,
          readModeId: archetype ? currentArchetypeMode(archetype, meta).id : null,
          taskKind: resolveTaskKind(node, references),
          canRun: canRunGenerationNode(node, ctx),
          incomingEdges: edges.filter((e) => e.target === s.nodeId).map((e) => ({ id: e.id, source: e.source, mode: e.mode ?? null })),
        }]
      }),
    )

    fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true })
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'canvas.json'), `${JSON.stringify(snapshot, null, 2)}\n`)
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, 'manifest.json'), `${JSON.stringify({
      release: 'v0.24.1',
      producedBy: 'tests/fixtures/old-user-data/generators/zzCanvasModeGen.ts.txt，在 v0.24.1 导出里用 0.24.1 的真实 store 写口（addNode / connectNodes / updateNode + applyArchetypeModeSwitch / copySelectedNodes + pasteNodes / disconnectEdge）和 buildPlannedNodeMeta 造节点，readDocumentSnapshot() 取存盘片段',
      regenerate: 'git archive v0.24.1 | tar -x -C <空目录>；链接 node_modules；把生成器放到 src/workbench/generationCanvas/store/zzCanvasModeGen.test.ts；V_OUT=<输出目录> pnpm exec vitest run 那个文件（README 里有全文）',
      canvasJsonIs: '项目文件 payload.generationCanvas 的存盘片段（readDocumentSnapshot 的原样输出）',
      scenarios,
      v0241Reads: reads,
    }, null, 2)}\n`)
    expect(nodes.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(scenarios.length)
  })
})

// ── 退回旧版本读得开（第二段，V_IN 给了才跑）──────────────────────────────
// 把「今天主线读写后存回的画布片段」（V_IN，一个 canvas.json 形状的文件）交给 0.24.1 自己的真读取：restoreSnapshot（0.24.1 的加载收敛照旧工作）
// + currentArchetypeMode / resolveTaskKind / canRunGenerationNode，和夹具 manifest（V_MANIFEST）里录下的 0.24.1 读法对账：
// 节点一个不少、方式读得出。每个节点的对账行写到 V_REPORT。
describe.skipIf(!process.env.V_IN)('zzCanvasModeReadBack', () => {
  it("0.24.1 reads what today's main wrote back", () => {
    const input = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(String(process.env.V_IN), 'utf8'))
    const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(String(process.env.V_MANIFEST), 'utf8')) as {
      scenarios: Array<{ key: string; nodeId: string }>
      v0241Reads: Record<string, { readModeId: string | null; taskKind: string; canRun: boolean }>
    }
    store().restoreSnapshot(input)
    const { nodes, edges } = store()
    const lines: string[] = []
    for (const s of manifest.scenarios) {
      const node = nodes.find((n) => n.id === s.nodeId)
      expect(node, `${s.key} missing after 0.24.1 load`).toBeTruthy()
      const meta = (node!.meta || {}) as Record<string, unknown>
      const archetypeId = (meta.archetype as { id?: string } | undefined)?.id
      const archetype = archetypeId ? archetypeOf(archetypeId) : null
      const refs = resolveGenerationReferences(node!, { nodes, edges })
      const got = {
        readModeId: archetype ? currentArchetypeMode(archetype, meta).id : null,
        taskKind: resolveTaskKind(node!, refs),
        canRun: canRunGenerationNode(node!, { nodes, edges }),
        incomingEdges: edges.filter((e) => e.target === s.nodeId).length,
      }
      const want = manifest.v0241Reads[s.key]!
      const same = got.readModeId === want.readModeId && got.taskKind === want.taskKind && got.canRun === want.canRun
      lines.push(`${s.key}\t0.24.1 读主线写回的：${got.readModeId}/${got.taskKind}/canRun=${got.canRun}/入边${got.incomingEdges}\t夹具录的：${want.readModeId}/${want.taskKind}/canRun=${want.canRun}\t${same ? '一致' : '不同'}`)
    }
    fs.writeFileSync(String(process.env.V_REPORT), lines.join('\n'))
  })
})
